profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, CA, whose AI-facing web presence centers on Gemini, described on its site as Google's AI assistant offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming. The company reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, filed as a 10-K, and trades under the ticker GOOGL with SEC CIK 0001652044.

Google's tracked AI product portfolio spans several categories. Gemini serves as its general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio is positioned for model prototyping by developers. NotebookLM provides document-grounded AI that ingests user-uploaded corpora. On the healthcare side, Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are medical large language models aimed at clinical reasoning and healthcare data use cases, with a HIPAA BAA required. Additional products include Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI, both integrated with Google Workspace, and TensorFlow and Keras, the company's open-source machine learning frameworks supporting MLOps through TensorFlow Extended.

The held facts record no litigation against Google in this dataset. A number of third-party MCP servers in the registry connect to Google services, including multiple Google Ads management servers, Google Search Console, Google News, Google Forms, Google Calendar, and Google Trends integrations, reflecting broad third-party development activity around Google's platforms.
